lede: The line was 122.24. Nishil scored 122.28 and Darrius scored 122.20. Four cents above, four cents below, the closest the median has been all season (Week 3 split it 0.26 both ways). Darrius started DK Metcalf ($19) at flex: one catch, two yards, 0.7. Alvin Kamara scored 6.7 on his bench. Swap them and he clears it by almost six. He lost to Barrett too, 0-2. Nishil lost to Greg (Miley) by 10.02 and got a win from the median for four cents. Jon scored 70.80, the second-lowest score of the season behind his own 68.94, with a perfect lineup for the fourth week running, and Tom beat him by 75.56. Barrett is 20-2 and has never lost to the median. Chris is 19-3 and lost to it by 4.60 with Tyler Shough on his bench. Will went from 174.40 to 89.66. And Justice Hill, added by Maclane three times this season and benched every time, got dropped, claimed by Nishil for $3, started, and scored 15.6.
